headline: Bose acquires audio rival Skullcandy
summary: Bose has acquired Skullcandy, betting the budget audio brand's reach and existing tech partnership will help it reach listeners Bose has been missing.

claims.statement: Bose has acquired audio rival Skullcandy.

sources.quote: Bose Is Buying Skullcandy. It’s Not as Weird as It Sounds
Bose announced today it has acquired Skullcandy.

claims.statement: The deal is meant to help Bose reach a wider audience it has been missing.

sources.quote: Bose acquires Skullcandy to help it reach a wider audience
Bose sees the company as a way to reach a wider audience.

claims.statement: Skullcandy will remain based in Park City, Utah.

sources.quote: By keeping Skullcandy in Park City, Utah, Bose is betting that skate cred and budget pricing will reach listeners it’s been missing.

claims.statement: Skullcandy had already partnered with Bose to bring Bose audio technology like spatial audio and noise cancellation to its own products.

sources.quote: Skullcandy recently partnered with its new owner to bring several of Bose's audio technologies - including its head-tracking spatial audio and excellent active noise cancellation (ANC) - to products like the Skullcandy Crusher 1080 ANC headphones and
